segments.text: After a meal, intestinal L-cells release GLP-1. Thirty amino acids. An enzyme, DPP-4, clears it in about two minutes. That brief incretin signal became the molecular basis of a major metabolic drug class.
This is the Omnigent interface on Databricks. Shared sessions. Tool cards. Agents panel. Policies. One meta-harness over coding agents and custom YAML agents alike.

Protein Lab is a short agent file. Harness, tools, guardrails. The agent calls Boltz in the cloud: sequence in, coordinates out. Our live run: structure confidence zero point eight three, P.L.D.D.T. zero point nine, thirty residues.
The fold, rendered from the predicted C.I.F. Omnigent session to structure movie. omni run, agents, protein-lab.
